title: Creatine kinase-MB (CK-MB)

review.note: Drafted from the source below; not yet reviewed by a medical professional.

measures: CK-MB is one of the three forms of the enzyme creatine kinase measured in a CK isoenzymes test. It is the form most linked to the heart muscle, and it is measured to help show where a high CK level is coming from.
context: A follow-up CK isoenzymes test is used when the source of a high CK level is not clear. Results are read with your symptoms and medical history, and a troponin test is often used as well for the heart.
aboveRange: High CK-MB most often relates to the heart muscle, for example from a heart attack or inflammation of the heart muscle (myocarditis)
May also relate to a blood clot in the lung, heart surgery, congestive heart failure, an underactive thyroid, or a kidney condition
nextStep: Discuss this result with your doctor.
